extension.summary: A Streamlined Utility Tool for Kodi
extension.description: No Bloatware, no Nonsense! Just Keep your Kodi sharp and clean with this utility tool... Now with a Custom Wizard. The "++" fork backs up and restores over Kodi's VFS, so Backup Location / Restore can point straight at a network share (nfs://, smb://) or any VFS path, not just local storage.
extension.news: v2026.07.04.0: Fix: backup/restore destination now strips an explicit :2049 port that Kodi's own NFS browse dialog bakes into the path - that form breaks Kodi's NFS write path (VfsCopyError / 0-byte copy). 2026.07.02.0 - Backup/Restore/One-Tap network copies now retry a failed NFS/SMB write instead of giving up on the first try. Kodi's own NFS client can leave a connection stale right after it auto-closes an idle one; a same-instant retry used to hit that same broken connection and fail again, so backups could fail even though the share was fine.
